verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server (docs.stripe.com/mcp) which would let AI agents interact with Stripe Connect via natural-language-driven tool calls, and also has an official CLI, but the evidence pack gives no detail on what Connect-specific actions are exposed via MCP or any hands-on confirmation of natural-language operation. missing for 10: details on MCP tool coverage for Connect operations, independent/hands-on validation of natural-language control, and confirmation beyond a bare 'documented at URL' probe.
